title: Everyday Phrases — An Online Course
scene_zh: 在線課程 · 情境對話
title_quote: I want to learn English online.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎓 實用在線課程必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — An Online Course
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用在線課程情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從選課試聽、付款開帳號，到打卡作業、結課證書，全部用最常聽到的說法。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical An Online Course phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering choosing a course, paying, homework, feedback and your certificate. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to learn English online.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個平台有很多好課程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I search for first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type listening in the search box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one has four point nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many lessons does it have?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, ten minutes fits my breaks.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，十分鐘剛好配我的休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每週的內容都列出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一點點，主要以口說為主。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One says the audio is soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you can speed it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This student finished in two months.
dialogue.zh: 這位學生兩個月就學完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her voice is calm and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I paused to take notes.
dialogue.zh: 於是我暫停下來做筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The full course is fifty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stop a monthly plan?
dialogue.zh: 月繳方案可以隨時停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set, I'll pay in full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, found one, twenty percent off!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 快把優惠代碼複製起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, where do I enter it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, no student card for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it good for my level?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I learn on my phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or should I use a laptop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 較大的螢幕對你有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你現在是學員了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用同一個電子郵件就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, I wrote it on paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My course is in the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you join the class group?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, one tip really helped me.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有一則小技巧幫了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家一起學習比較有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a quiz after the video.
dialogue.zh: 影片後面有一個小測驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, four out of five right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，先把影片下載下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, lost the last sentence there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一點五倍反而聽得更清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I replayed the hard words.
dialogue.zh: 於是我把難懂的詞重聽了幾遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I mark a lesson done?
dialogue.zh: 可以把課程標成完成嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll skip week five for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那一單元你現在還太難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep the subtitles on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 英文字幕對你幫助較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote down a new word.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app has a word list?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished the whole first lesson!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to check in daily?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə tʃɛk ɪn ˈdeɪli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I checked in for day two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 連續七天可以得到徽章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A badge? How fun is that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm shy to share my voice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the teacher will hear it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她修正了我的動詞時態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I send my work again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以重新交一次作業嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I asked about used to.
dialogue.zh: 我問了表示過去常做的句型。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是個很好的語法問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我沒辦法每個字都聽懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I watched it at half speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 回聽自己的聲音好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家都聽不慣自己的錄音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 同學可以互評我的作業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡健二的短演講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 健二給了我很好的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 同學的點評感覺不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看別人的作業也有收穫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我學到最後一個單元了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it like the small quizzes?
dialogue.zh: 跟平時的小測驗一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那要專心留一小時給它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 最後我把筆記全部複習了一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 前二十題一下子就寫完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished with five minutes left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 因為你每週都認真學了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I made it my lock screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以把它發到網上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll talk about it all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi l ˈtɔk əˈbaʊt ɪt ɔl deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以分享驗證連結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next course is level two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do past students get a deal?
dialogue.zh: 舊學員報下一級有優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you can test it safely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I don't like it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add an example to each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my plan sounds simple now.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的計畫現在聽起來很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每天晚上只要十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在聽力完全不同了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 聽播客覺得輕鬆些了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I got the main idea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們再一起開始。
